flags.why: Bạc xỉu can be served hot or iced, so “iced” incorrectly restricts its meaning ([café usage](https://www.virginsaigon.com/blog/what-is-bac-xiu/)).
flags.fix: milk coffee (a little coffee in a lot of condensed milk)

flags.why: The example uses “sáng bảnh mắt” to mean broad daylight rather than using “bảnh mắt” to mean waking up ([attested usage](https://nhandan.vn/buoi-sang-mua-he-post365452.html)).
flags.fix: Vừa bảnh mắt, anh ấy đã đi làm. = As soon as he woke up, he went to work.

flags.why: “Nhà nào cũng” means every household, whereas the translation says only “a family.”
flags.fix: For the whole forty-nine days, every household offers meals for the deceased.
